3179.title: Mobile command menu can render beyond the visual viewport
3179.rootCauseOneLine: The new-thread command menu is absolutely placed below the composer without visual-viewport collision handling.
3179.proposedFix: Add a compact visual-viewport-bounded command surface with an explicit keyboard-preserving focus policy, then verify it on Android Chrome.
3179.caveats: The new-thread surface reproduced twice; the exact existing-thread physical-keyboard case remains unverified.
